item.title: Best Field Service App for Solar Subbies: Replace WhatsApp
item.description:
Most solar install businesses I know have the same setup. They don’t have a “system”. They have a WhatsApp group with the boss, the office, three crews and a subbie who left eight months ago and still gets every message.

Job addresses go in there. So do switchboard photos, roof shots, serial number labels, “running late” texts, a photo of someone’s dog, and a voice note about which inverter is on the ute. It works fine until somebody needs to find something. Then it stops working completely.

item.title: Solar Defect Rectification Job Management for Installers
item.description: Every field service tool sold to solar installers has a tidy list of features on the pricing page: scheduling, invoicing, job tracking, customer profiles. Callbacks and defect work, if they appear at all, are a bullet point near the bottom. The vendors building job management software for solar jobs (WorkBuddy, n.d.) and the ones pitching job management for solar companies (Klipboard, n.d.) treat the return visit as a minor scheduling event. Book a tech, close the job, move on.
